gridPredicate: Each 等第 column assigns every Month Jian to exactly one cell; the cell's listed partners describe what co-occurs with the subject in that month. Selection is (subject, Month Jian); verified by test over 11 columns × 12 months, not assumed.
deRule: Bare 遇德 of the grade table is resolved per (subject, month) to the gods the subject's own entry clause names for that month (or the deferral terminal's clause). No global 德 boolean; a clause without a named group is unconditional.
